# PR creation accepts a selector, preserves raw failure stderr, and retains recovery.
exec zwm -C project wpr 123
cmpenv stdout created
! stderr .

exec zwm -C project wpr 123
cmpenv stdout focused
! stderr .

# Force resets the existing managed worktree to the pull request's latest remote state.
exec zwm -C project wpr -f 123
cmpenv stdout focused
! stderr .

assert-exit 64 zwm -C project wpr 789
stderr '^zwm: usage: could not resolve pull request .789.\n$'

assert-exit 1 zwm -C project wpr 456
stderr 'fake gh: injected checkout failure for 456\nzwm: recovery: detached managed pull-request worktree remains at .+; inspect it and complete or remove it manually when safe\nzwm: external: could not checkout pull request\n'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- created --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_PR_PATH
display_identity=pr-123-feature/pr-ready
tab_action=created
tab_title=project:pr-123
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_PR_PATH
-- focused --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_PR_PATH
display_identity=pr-123-feature/pr-ready
tab_action=focused
tab_title=project:pr-123
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_PR_PATH
-- want-log --
